question: Should Browser CLI `--fields-file` adopt a hard 1 MiB compatibility limit, and if so what documented upgrade behavior should existing larger valid payloads receive?
rationale: The branch introduces a new public CLI rejection threshold rather than repairing an established bounded-input contract, so maintainers must choose the supported limit and compatibility posture.

options.title: Define and ship a supported limit
options.body: Approve a documented size contract, include an upgrade path for larger existing payloads, and require boundary tests plus live CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve current acceptance
options.body: Do not add an unconditional cap until a compatible resource-control design is agreed for existing field files.

recommendation.title: Define and ship a supported limit
recommendation.body: Approve a documented size contract, include an upgrade path for larger existing payloads, and require boundary tests plus live CLI proof before merge.
